nodes.name: forward_return_labels.json
nodes.summary: Committed benchmark artifact holding forward-return labels aggregated by regime and horizon for both real corpus and synthetic decision points, plus coverage and tool provenance.
nodes.languageNotes: Large pinned artifact (1159 lines) reproduced byte-identically by run_forward_return_labels.py.

nodes.name: run_forward_return_labels.py
nodes.summary: Calibration benchmark that derives forward-return labels (direction correctness, directional PnL) for decision points across horizons and aggregates them by regime, writing the forward_return_labels.json artifact.
nodes.languageNotes: Deterministic label builder consuming the layer-2 corpus and emitting a pinned JSON artifact.

nodes.name: execution_bench.json
nodes.summary: Pinned execution benchmark artifact recording byte-identical replay results, policy and fill-model fingerprints, portfolio state hashes, and guard-block attribution.

nodes.name: run_execution_bench.py
nodes.summary: Execution benchmark that replays real and synthetic order sequences twice to assert byte-identical fills and portfolio state hashes, attributing guard blocks and fingerprinting the execution policy.

nodes.name: gold_bench.json
nodes.summary: Gold decision benchmark artifact pinning the decision-policy fingerprint, determinism results, and a synthetic confidence/uncertainty sweep over the decision grid.

nodes.name: paper_runtime_bench.json
nodes.summary: Pinned paper-trading runtime benchmark artifact recording real and synthetic ledger replay sequences, runtime-policy fingerprint, and ledger state hashes.

nodes.name: run_gold_bench.py
nodes.summary: Gold benchmark that checks decision determinism on repeated classification and runs a synthetic confidence/uncertainty sweep across a feature grid, emitting gold_bench.json.

nodes.name: run_paper_runtime_bench.py
nodes.summary: Paper-trading runtime benchmark that replays real and synthetic gold decision packets through the ledger twice to verify byte-identical records and state hashes, writing paper_runtime_bench.json.

nodes.name: chain_bench.json
nodes.summary: Pinned end-to-end chain orchestration benchmark artifact recording byte-identical replay of the full decision-to-execution chain with ledger/portfolio state hashes and the composite replay key.

nodes.name: run_chain_bench.py
nodes.summary: Orchestration benchmark that runs the full real decision chain twice to assert byte-identical ledger and portfolio outputs, composing a replay key from all stage fingerprints into chain_bench.json.

nodes.name: regime_bench.json
nodes.summary: Pinned regime-classifier benchmark artifact recording determinism of classification, classifier/taxonomy versions, decision fingerprint, and a synthetic feature sweep.

nodes.name: run_regime_bench.py
nodes.summary: Regime benchmark that verifies the classifier is deterministic on repeated runs and sweeps a synthetic feature grid to characterize regime stability and entropy, emitting regime_bench.json.

nodes.name: Alpaca API Docs.md
nodes.summary: Permitted API documentation reference node scoping Alpaca trading/market-data API usage, retrieval method, authentication, and version notes for the dev_graph.

nodes.name: Anthropic API Docs.md
nodes.summary: Permitted API documentation reference node scoping Anthropic (Claude) API usage, retrieval method, authentication, and version notes for the dev_graph.

nodes.name: Upgrade Evaluation.md
nodes.summary: Capability node defining the upgrade-evaluation behavior — comparing candidate policy/model versions against pinned benchmarks to gate promotion decisions.

nodes.name: Context Pack Template.md
nodes.summary: Reusable context-pack template defining the canonical sections (task, retrieved nodes, required files/tests/constraints, admissibility, implementation/validation/writeback plans) for assembling Claude coding context.

nodes.name: Phase 5 Bootstrap Context.md
nodes.summary: Concrete Phase 5 context pack instantiating the template to drive substrate decision work (ADR-003), listing required nodes, files, tests, constraints, and an implementation/validation plan.

nodes.name: Dev Graph Dashboard.md
nodes.summary: Consolidated observability dashboard with 22 Dataview-driven sections covering node inventory, type/status distribution, orphan/stale detection, coverage gaps, and benchmark inventory for the dev_graph.
nodes.languageNotes: Dataview-query-heavy Obsidian dashboard; queries are scoped FROM "dev_graph" per governance.

nodes.name: Operations Control Plane Console.md
nodes.summary: Observability node describing the Operations Control Plane console — its inputs, the operational signals and gated actions it surfaces, and the constraints governing operator interaction.

nodes.name: System Lifecycle.md
nodes.summary: Workflow node specifying the system lifecycle state machine — its states, transitions, and transition guards governing how a system moves from planned through validated to deprecated.

nodes.name: app.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI read-only backend for the JARVIS graph explorer and GraphRAG console: exposes Neo4j-bridged graph endpoints (node, neighbors, search, shortest-path, subgraph), a fail-closed /ask GraphRAG route over graph.json, and optional Whisper/Piper voice STT/TTS.
nodes.languageNotes: Read-only by design: sessions open in READ mode and _guard() rejects mutating Cypher; /ask is fail-closed (no seed match -> no LLM call).

nodes.name: requirements.txt
nodes.summary: Python dependency pin list for the JARVIS backend (FastAPI/uvicorn, neo4j driver, anthropic, and optional voice deps).

nodes.name: export_graph_json.py
nodes.summary: Projection script that scans the dev_graph markdown via sync_to_neo4j helpers and emits the canonical graph.json (nodes + resolved relationship edges) consumed by the frontend explorer and backend /ask corpus.

nodes.name: install.sh
nodes.summary: POSIX shell installer that copies the repo's pre-commit hook into the local clone's .git/hooks and marks it executable, since git does not version .git/hooks.
nodes.languageNotes: Linear shell script with no defined functions; uses git rev-parse to locate the repo root.

nodes.name: pre-commit
nodes.summary: DB-free git pre-commit hook that, when staged dev_graph markdown changes, regenerates graph.json via export_graph_json.py and blocks the commit if the staged graph.json projections are stale.
nodes.languageNotes: POSIX shell hook; never contacts Neo4j and compares against staged blobs via git show + cmp.

nodes.name: DecisionPoint
nodes.summary: Frozen dataclass describing a labeled decision point (snapshot id, clock timestamp, entry price, regime, direction) used as the input unit for forward-return labeling.

nodes.name: direction_correct
nodes.summary: Determines whether a predicted direction matched the realized forward return given a flat band, returning correctness for directional accuracy scoring.

nodes.name: select_exit
nodes.summary: Selects the exit price point for a labeled entry at a given trading-day horizon, respecting a maximum gap-day tolerance.

nodes.name: label_point
nodes.summary: Produces the full label record for one decision point at one horizon, computing forward return, directional PnL, move sign, and direction correctness.

nodes.name: _aggregate_cell
nodes.summary: Aggregates a group of label rows into a regime/horizon cell of mean/median return, directional accuracy, and hit-rate statistics by direction.

nodes.name: decision_points_from_corpus
nodes.summary: Consumes layer-2 corpus snapshots, builds features and classifies/decides each, and yields deduplicated DecisionPoint records for labeling.

nodes.name: build_report
nodes.summary: Assembles the full calibration artifact report combining synthetic and (optionally) external-corpus labeled sections with parameters and provenance.

nodes.name: _replay_block
nodes.summary: Runs an execution sequence twice and asserts byte-identical fill records and portfolio state hashes, summarizing determinism and guard-config fingerprint for a labeled block.

nodes.name: _build_chain
nodes.summary: Builds the decision-to-execution chain input from a corpus snapshot path: consumes, builds features, classifies, and constructs the operational input with snapshot guards.

nodes.name: run_real
nodes.summary: Evaluates real corpus snapshots into admitted execution items and replays them to verify deterministic real-sequence execution.

nodes.name: run_synthetic
nodes.summary: Constructs admitted synthetic decision records and replays them to exercise guard-block attribution and deterministic synthetic execution.

nodes.name: build_report
nodes.summary: Assembles the execution benchmark report combining real and synthetic results with policy/fill-model fingerprints and guard-block attribution.

nodes.name: run_determinism
nodes.summary: Builds features and classifies corpus inputs twice, asserting that the gold decision serialization is byte-identical across repeated runs.

nodes.name: run_synthetic_sweep
nodes.summary: Sweeps a synthetic feature grid through the decision policy to characterize confidence and uncertainty statistics across the input space.

nodes.name: _replay_block
nodes.summary: Replays a sequence of gold decision packets through the runtime ledger twice and asserts byte-identical records and ledger state hashes.

nodes.name: _synthetic_packet
nodes.summary: Constructs a synthetic GoldDecisionPacket with confidence inputs and guard refs for a given snapshot id, direction, guards, and regime.

nodes.name: run_synthetic
nodes.summary: Builds a fan of synthetic decision packets across directions and guard states and replays them through the runtime ledger to verify determinism.

nodes.name: _replay_key
nodes.summary: Composes the end-to-end replay key by combining decision-policy, execution-policy, fill-model, guard-config, operational-input, and runtime-policy fingerprints.

nodes.name: run_real
nodes.summary: Runs the full real decision-to-execution chain twice over loaded corpus snapshots and asserts byte-identical ledger and portfolio outputs and state hashes.

nodes.name: run_determinism
nodes.summary: Classifies corpus feature vectors twice and asserts the regime classification trace is byte-identical, validating classifier determinism.

nodes.name: run_synthetic_sweep
nodes.summary: Sweeps a synthetic feature grid through the regime classifier and computes label distribution, rule utilization, and entropy to characterize classifier behavior.

nodes.name: run_read
nodes.summary: Executes a read-only Cypher query against Neo4j inside a READ-mode session after the mutation guard, returning records as dicts.

nodes.name: _graph
nodes.summary: Flattens Neo4j records (nodes, relationships, and path keys) into a deduplicated node/edge graph payload for the explorer endpoints.

nodes.name: neighbors
nodes.summary: FastAPI endpoint returning the neighborhood subgraph of a canonical node up to a bounded depth and direction via parameterized Cypher.

nodes.name: subgraph
nodes.summary: FastAPI endpoint returning a label-scoped subgraph of nodes and edges, validating the label name with isalnum before embedding it in Cypher.

nodes.name: _score
nodes.summary: Scores a graph.json node against a normalized query by token and substring overlap to rank seed matches for the GraphRAG /ask flow.

nodes.name: _neighborhood
nodes.summary: Expands a seed node into its graph.json neighborhood (using the live neighbors endpoint plus offline edges) to assemble GraphRAG retrieval context.

nodes.name: _context_block
nodes.summary: Renders a retrieved subgraph into a textual context block of node summaries for inclusion in the Claude prompt.

nodes.name: _claude_answer
nodes.summary: Calls the Anthropic Claude API with the assembled graph context to answer the user's question, failing closed when the API key is missing.

nodes.name: ask
nodes.summary: Fail-closed GraphRAG /ask endpoint: matches a seed node, expands its neighborhood, builds context, calls Claude, and extracts cited canonical ids — returning a not-in-graph message when no seed matches.

nodes.name: voice_stt
nodes.summary: Voice speech-to-text endpoint that transcribes uploaded audio via a lazily-loaded Whisper model and returns the recognized text.

nodes.name: voice_tts
nodes.summary: Voice text-to-speech endpoint that synthesizes audio from text via the Piper binary subprocess and streams the resulting WAV bytes.

nodes.name: first_sentence_of_definition
nodes.summary: Extracts the first sentence of a dev_graph node's Definition section, stripping wikilinks, to use as the node summary in the exported graph.json.

nodes.name: build_graph
nodes.summary: Scans the dev_graph markdown, parses frontmatter and relationship sections via sync_to_neo4j helpers, resolves edge targets, and builds the sorted node/edge graph.json payload.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: CLI entry point that builds the graph and either prints pure JSON to stdout or writes graph.json to the configured projection paths.
